result.topic_en: Euler determines the integration constants for the statically bent elastic lamina from boundary conditions, derives the value of the elasticity constant cc from a single deflection experiment, and begins discussing the successive species of vibration and their frequencies.
result.transcription:
LAMINARVM ELASTICARVM. 465

XX. Quum nunc in ipſo puncto K, vbi $x=0$, applicata $y$ per hypotheſin aequetur interuallo $Kk=i$, euidens eſt fore:
$\frac{Kcc.i}{I}=\beta.$
Praeterea poſito $x=k$ fieri debet $y=0$, vnde colligimus
$\frac{1}{6}k^{3}+\alpha+\frac{cc.i}{I}=0$, ideoque $\alpha=-\frac{1}{6}k^{2}-\frac{Kcc.i}{kI}$,
denique in eodem puncto A fieri debet $\frac{dy}{dx}=0$, ex quo colligitur
$0=\frac{1}{2}x^{2}+\alpha=\frac{1}{2}k^{2}+\alpha$ ſeu $\alpha=-\frac{1}{2}k^{2}$,
qui valor praecedenti aequatus ſuppeditat:
$cc=\frac{1}{3}\frac{Ik^{3}}{Ki}.$
Sicque pro qualibet lamina valor huius conſtantis $cc$ per vnicum experimentum facile exploratur, hincque pro noſtris formulis fit
$b^{4}=\frac{2}{3}\cdot\frac{Ibk^{4}}{Ki}$,
quo cognito, numeri illi vibrationum vno minuto ſecundo editarum perfecte innoteſcunt.

XXI. Eadem igitur lamina elaſtica diuerſas vibrationum ſpecies recipere poteſt, prouti ſine dubio initio aliam atque aliam impulſionem acceperit, prima ſcilicet ſpecies dat ſonum grauiſſimum, ſequentes continuo magis intenduntur fiuntque acutiores, ipſi autem vibrationum numeri mox poſt primam ſpeciem ſecundum quadrata numerorum naturalium increſcunt, praecipuum autem diſcrimen ha-
Tom. XVII. Nou. Comm. Nnn rum

items.quote: Sicque pro qualibet lamina valor huius conſtantis $cc$ per vnicum experimentum facile exploratur
items.english: And thus for any lamina the value of this constant cc is easily found by a single experiment

items.quote: ipſi autem vibrationum numeri mox poſt primam ſpeciem ſecundum quadrata numerorum naturalium increſcunt
items.english: but the numbers of vibrations themselves, soon after the first species, increase according to the squares of the natural numbers
